plan.archetype: Efficient attacks into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Set up powers during sleep, then maintain poison through stat drains. Prepare efficient block, reliable weak, upgraded poison, and useful potions.
plan.summary: Take efficient damage first, then poison and scalable defense. Favor manageable normal fights for rewards and Fishing Rod upgrades. Challenge elites with strong damage and potions; remove Strikes after obtaining replacements.
